speaker: Merchant
notes: YOK-159. Speech-bubble lines for the shop. Designer decisions: every bubble is at most 2 sentences (S2 applies to bubbles), and the shop lines carry no copy hinting; the merchant reads as a pleasant, ordinary shopkeeper. The row-4 line 'That {move} of yours... I'd love one.' lives only on the S3 story card (data/story/merchant-row4.json), not here. No stock or rarity promises (R6: never sells rares). Placeholders: only item_focused uses any ({name}, {card_text}, both new). {card_text} is only the plain-language line of the item card block (A12: frame data sits behind a toggle and is never spoken), inserted verbatim from the card block. Selection rule for item_focused: count sentences of lead-in + card text; if that would exceed 2, show the card text alone. The lead-ins are fragments that join the card text's first sentence, so a 1-sentence card text gives a 1-sentence bubble. Checked 2026-10-20: every card plain line in data/moves and data/modifiers (specials, modifiers and level lines) is 1 sentence, so none bypass the lead-in today. Re-check when a card plain line gains a second sentence. Lives in data/story/shop/ so StoryLibrary (top-level *.json, throws on other kinds) does not load it.

greeting_row4.trigger: Row 4 merchant visit, before the heal-or-shop choice
variants: Welcome, Ryo! Take a look around.
Ah, a customer! Have a browse, friend.
Come in, come in. Mind the step.
Back again! Welcome, welcome.
Welcome, welcome. I've set out a fresh shelf for you.
Good to see you again, Ryo.

item_focused.trigger: A shelf item is hovered or focused: the bubble speaks a lead-in joined to the item card text (designer decision, YOK-159)
item_focused.notes: Modifier tags are dropped (the MODIFIER mark and the target step already say the player picks the special). Selection rule: if lead-in + card text would exceed 2 sentences, show the card text alone. Lead-ins never alter or paraphrase the card text. 'Care for {name}? {card_text}' is a question plus the card sentence, so 2 sentences in total, still within the limit.

variants: Sold! Treat it kindly.
Sold! It will serve you well.
A fine choice. Thank you!

bought_modifier.trigger: Ryo buys a modifier and attaches it to a special (R6, A2)
variants: A little polish on your move. Lovely.
Clever! Sold.
Sold! That should make a difference.

cannot_afford.trigger: Ryo tries to buy with too few coins
variants: Ah, not quite enough coins. Win a few more, friend.
So close! Come back when your purse is heavier.
Fair is fair, I'm afraid.

slot_full.trigger: Ryo tries to buy a special with every slot full; a replaced move loses its levels (A6)
variants: Hands full! Swap one out? It forgets its levels, mind.
No room. Something must go, levels and all.
You can't hold more. Choose carefully.

release_binding.trigger: Ryo pays 40 to release a binding (R6)
variants: Letting one go? Kind of you. Forty, if you please.
Off it drifts. Forty, thank you.
Free, then. Forty coins, and a kind deed.

release_last_special.trigger: Ryo tries to release his last special (T5): the merchant refuses
variants: Not that one! It's all you have left.
Oh no, no. You'd be empty-handed.
That one stays with you. Trust a shopkeeper.

shelf_empty.trigger: No items left on the shelf
variants: All gone! You've cleaned me out.
Nothing left but dust and good manners.
Empty shelves. Come back when the road has given you more.
Off you go. Safe road, Ryo!
Safe travels, friend.
Goodbye, goodbye! Mind how you go.
